title: SignalPlanActivated
description: A controller began running a different timing plan. Covers scheduled changes, operator overrides, adaptive selection, and falls back. Version 1.1.0 adds one value to `reason`, which is the additive enum change SPEC section 9 permits.

previous_plan_id.description: Plan that was in force. Absent on cold start.

reason.description: Why the plan changed. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values. 1.1.0 adds "adaptive-fallback", the case where adaptive selection itself failed and the controller fell back; 1.0.0 reported it as "fallback" and lost the distinction.

effective_at.description: When the new plan took effect.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
